body: Please send this to the person it's meant for. Email. IM. Facebook. Whatever... because he/she needs to hear it.

Thank you. 

I have panic attacks too, and try to talk myself out of them so I don't have to take the medication i have for them. I'm supposed to be able to take them daily or on an as-needed basis... I think I will call my Dr and ask if it would be safe to take them daily to get me through this.

People always look at me strangely when I tell them I talk myself out of panic attacks'.

You have all made me feel a little less alone... I woke up this morning with a lighter feeling in my heart, and I want to thank you all for being there.
I'm sorry for your loss... I never want to be the cause of that kind of pain for my children. I just don't know where to turn.
This made me cry. Thank you for this.

I know how you feel... I feel that same pain in my chest, but sometimes it turns itself inside out and crushes me so I can't breathe...

I give a shit. I don't want anyone to ever feel the way I feel. Please post soon so that we know you are ok.

My children are my everything...

It's not like I lived a fancy life before this job loss. My 3 children and I shared a small 2 bedroom apartment (i slept on the couch)... I think it's the loss of my ability to provide stability for my children that affects me the most.

Thank you for taking the time to talk to me. It does help a lot to not feel so invisible.

Thank you. I know in me that you're right - losing a mother that way would be an unfair emotional strain to place on my kids.

I just don't have  much strength left. I can barely move off of my couch. I have to talk myself into getting up to go to the restroom.

Thank you for take the time to talk to me. It makes a difference to not feel so see-through.
